integrity: Proof supplies explicit matrices, zero-spacing valuations, complete mod-eight projective table, lift and count; standalone finite orbit enumeration is corroboration rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact zero avoidance for Fibonacci pairs modulo powers of two only, not unit-only recurrence solutions or arbitrary moduli. Equivalence to unlocated literature remains possible; one potentially related 2020 primary full text was unavailable. No independent mathematical validation.
title: A mod-eight criterion and exact census for zero-avoiding dyadic Fibonacci orbits
